test.create_query: CREATE TABLE limit_zero_pk (c1 DateTime, c2 UInt8, c3 LowCardinality(String), c4 UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree PRIMARY KEY (c1, c2, c3) ORDER BY (c1, c2, c3, c4)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO limit_zero_pk SELECT toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00') + intDiv(number, 100000), (number % 100000) >= 50000, concat('ex', toString(cityHash64(number) % 20)), toUInt32(cityHash64(number, 1) % 50) FROM numbers_mt(600000000)
test.query: SELECT c1, c4 FROM limit_zero_pk WHERE c4 = 1 AND c2 LIMIT 0
